ai_diagnosis.root_cause: Extended Access Control List (ACL) 101 explicitly denies TCP port 80 (HTTP) traffic from the Sales subnet (192.168.10.0/24) to the Web Server (10.0.0.10).
evidence: Web server port 80 unreachable from Sales subnet
fix_steps: Step 1: Remove the denying entry from ACL 101 using command 'no access-list 101 deny tcp 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255 host 10.0.0.10 eq 80'
Step 2: Add a permit entry allowing HTTP access: 'access-list 101 permit tcp 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255 host 10.0.0.10 eq 80'
Step 3: Verify the updated access list rules with 'show access-lists 101'
ai_diagnosis.explanation: The output of the show command explicitly displays rule 'access-list 101 deny tcp 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255 host 10.0.0.10 eq 80', which directly blocks TCP traffic on destination port 80 from the 192.168.10.0/24 network to 10.0.0.10. This directly matches the reported symptom.
